roundLayoutLaw: roundLayout is the union of allowed evidence artifacts, not a requirement to materialize every entry in every round
checkpointEvidenceLaw: Every R1-R4 and R7 calibration and cohort checkpoint materializes checkpoint.json, visual-craft.json, paired before/after captures for three representative families in both tenants, one narrow/mobile capture per representative family, CSS ownership/causality receipts and an explicit Codex GO or correction receipt before further writes.

minimumReliableEvidenceByRound.R0: manifests, source/public-export inventory, impact baseline and new negative drills; no captures or recordings
minimumReliableEvidenceByRound.R1: complete evidence for the twelve reference canaries rendered only through /probe/ds-reference, including double-tenant contact sheets with identical hardcoded content, all eight lab scenes, zero product-application dependencies and applicable drills
minimumReliableEvidenceByRound.R2: fresh scorecard per primitive, one representative capture set per ownership lane and drills for every touched veto
minimumReliableEvidenceByRound.R3: fresh scorecard per pattern/chart, one representative capture set per ownership lane and drills for every touched veto
minimumReliableEvidenceByRound.R4: fresh scorecard per structure/surface/commercial family, one representative capture set per ownership lane and drills for every touched veto
minimumReliableEvidenceByRound.R5: complete canon, parity, propagation, prototype and source-to-artifact evidence for all touched scope
minimumReliableEvidenceByRound.R6: complete frozen-tree machine serial, sighted matrix, captures, recordings and requirement-by-requirement certification
minimumReliableEvidenceByRound.R7: complete 252-family customization disposition and anatomy matrix, live token and CSS ownership census, fourteen-group recipe propagation and restore matrix, benchmark capability dispositions, Standard Pro Expert editor evidence, five-posture ten-pair divergence evidence, R6 regression comparison and frozen-tree independent certification

regenerationLaw: The single R5 integrator regeneration changes ownership digests, forces conflict-graph recalculation and invalidates any receipt whose source digest no longer matches. R7 may perform one additional governed regeneration after its own source freeze; it has the same digest invalidation law. Any other regeneration requires re-emitting affected receipts.
statusLaw: Evidence files may describe results, but only roadmap/registry.json owns WO status.
roundProgressCommand: pnpm roadmap:status progress WO-CRA-23 --note <concise evidence pointer> --by claude-modern-rescue
